notes: The correlative both ... and belongs whole to the waw, headed on the closing connective, since no other morpheme in the clause is what both says (rule 14).
betokhkem fuses the preposition with tavekh as one unit for among (rule 30), headed on the lexeme-bearing morpheme.
The clause's negation is recast onto the nominal, so lo takes no and hayah keeps the presentative there be (rules 15, 21).
